# meca-suelo-bosque (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F2, Templo del Bosque), A: both ADULT at the entrance; a floor switch stood on for real, then room 17's switch flag.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 12-bosque
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 219
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test place 17.13 100.50 -17.16: done within pisa..end
#! expect A coop: flags debug: (bool 0x[0-9a-f]{8} \(entry|key64 0x[0-9a-f]+ \(record) \d+\) 0 -> 1 within pisa..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: (bool 0x[0-9a-f]{8} \(entry|key64 0x[0-9a-f]+ \(record) \d+\) 0 -> 1 within pisa..end
#! expect A coop: test flag ForestTemple_Room17_Switch_On_01 \(0x985d21fd\) = 1: queued within abierta..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x985d21fd \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within abierta..end
mark start
warp ForestTemple ForestTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark pisa
place 17.13 100.50 -17.16   # on the floor switch a60352c96c7679c3
wait 360
place 17.13 100.60 -15.16   # off it
wait 120
mark abierta
flag ForestTemple_Room17_Switch_On_01 1
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
